message.reasoning_content: Law 3: subsidy_goods=1. Good for everyone; I produce via shuttle, and rivals also produce. Vote yes passed already. Should I veto? Subsidy helps rivals equally; I have 3 goods + shuttle next round gives 4. Rivals also get goods. Vetoing subsidy keeps production at base 2 — actually shuttle base 3. Subsidy adds 1 to all. Net zero relative? All get +1, so relative advantage neutral. But more goods → more sales → pushes price counter down. I plan to sell big; rivals selling more lowers prices. Veto reduces rival production, keeps prices higher for my final sales. Also veto costs nothing. So veto.
